title: Wand guide

rows: Quick tap from closed
Switch app once, after waiting at most 0.3 s for a second click
Double click from closed
Right-click at the pointer, with mouse follow on or off
Hold, turn, release
Open the HUD, point to a card and use it on release; the HUD stays open
In an open HUD or submenu
Move the wand to outline a card without holding the HUD button, then click it, or hold, aim and release, to use it. Select as many times as you want
Adjustable card
Click it, or release on it, to select it (dots); hold the HUD button and move to adjust, release to stop and reset the wand; tap to deselect
Hold the HUD button on an adjustable card
In wedge selection, hold and move the way its arrows point, like scrolling: values up or down; Spaces, scrolling, tabs and history left or right. Release to stop
Release a hold on Switch App

Armed for the next hold: unheld movement can still pick other cards; hold the HUD button on Switch App, move left or right, release to switch; in an open HUD a fresh hold on Switch App chooses at once
Go out twice on a card
Outer quick actions: Undo beyond Keys, Space beyond Enter, and in VS Code Review changes and Stage files beyond the app card. New Codex chat is on the main ring
Go out a third time on Utility
Zoom, beyond Utility
In VS Code review
Circle clockwise for next and anticlockwise for previous; click the HUD button to exit, double-click to swap Review changes and Stage files, hold to stage the selection
Double click in an open HUD
Close the entire HUD
Tap from off
Enter high-sensitivity follow without clicking
Stop after moving in HIGH
Click once after a 200 ms pause
While choosing where to click

Keep moving the wand slightly while you are not certain about placement so it does not click. Stop when you are ready. The pointer must still be moving; tiny movements filtered out as hand noise do not prevent a click.
Tap while following
Stop following without clicking
Hold
Over a scroll area, drag to scroll. Holding still continues page scrolling; sideways swipes end when the stroke stops. A confirmed draggable target drags instead. Release stops the gesture.
Tap, then hold the second press
Drag with the mouse button down; release to drop
Double tap
Centre the pointer on the main screen and enable mouse follow after the 300 ms triple-tap window; keep HUD and review selection unchanged
Triple tap
Start screenshot selection; hold the mouse button and move to select the area, then release to capture
Tap
Start Agent Flow dictation
Tap again
Stop and paste
Double tap while recording or transcribing
Won’t paste: copy the text without pasting it

power: All three grip buttons turn off; any single button wakes. Release all before another action.
The light turns off after a minute; pick the wand up to wake it
After 5 minutes, every light flashes twice and the wand sleeps; press any button to wake it

lights.name: Pointer
lights.detail: Steady blue; recording takes priority and shows red

lights.name: App review
lights.detail: Green for app review; purple for VS Code file staging

lights.name: Recording
lights.detail: Steady red while recording, including mouse mode. HUD, review, scrolling and loading keep their own colours.

lights.name: Updating
lights.detail: Blinks orange while loading or updating the device code

lights.name: Sleeping
lights.detail: Off after a minute on the desk; pickup restores the light
